crossRefs.note: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered…
In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in…
So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria…
Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife.…
Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him…
Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

people.name: Eden
people.line: A city or region, possibly in Mesopotamia or Syria.

people.name: Gozan
people.line: A region in Mesopotamia where Israelite captives were deported.

people.name: Haran
people.line: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.

people.name: Telassar
people.line: Mesopotamian city conquered by the Assyrians

translations.web: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
translations.bsb: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers rescue those nations—the gods of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and of the people of Eden in Telassar?
translations.kjv: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?
translations.asv: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden that were in Telassar?
